descriptionChirho: A proper noun referring to one or more places named Rehob (רְחוֹב), including a Levitical city in Asher and a location near the entrance to Hamath. The two clusters differ only in transliteration convention (Rehob/Rechov) and gender tagging, not in referent: eng Rehob/Rechov, spa Rejob/Rejov, hin रहोब/रहोब-के, arb وَ-רָחוּב/רָחוֹב, kor 르홉의/르홉을, swa Rehobu/Rehobu. All point to the same toponym.
